select a.id,a.balance_no,a.balance_weight,a.balance_price,a.balance_amount,a.add_time, b.license_plate,b.carrier_name,b.job_no,b.job_type,b.card_no from task_flow_balance_item a left join task_flow b on (a.task_id=b.id)
and a.add_user=#{userId}
and (to_char(a.add_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= #{startTime})
and (to_char(a.add_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= #{endTime})
order by a.add_time desc

select a.job_no,COALESCE(b.deduction,0) as deduction,COALESCE(b.deduction_price,0) as deduction_price, COALESCE(c.gross_weight,0) as gross_weight,COALESCE(c.tare_weight,0) as tare_weight,COALESCE(c.net_weight,0) as net_weight, COALESCE(d.deduct_weight,0) as deduct_weight, e.card as id_card,e.phone as link_phone,e.bank_code,e.bank_name,e.bank_account from task_flow a left join task_flow_quality_item b on (a.id=b.task_id) left join ( select task_id,sum(gross_weight) as gross_weight,sum(tare_weight) as tare_weight, sum(gross_weight)-sum(tare_weight) as net_weight from ( select task_id,case weight_type when 1 then weight end as gross_weight, case weight_type when 2 then weight end as tare_weight from task_flow_weight_item where task_id=#{taskId} ) tb group by task_id ) c on (a.id=c.task_id) left join task_flow_warehouse_item d on (a.id=d.task_id and d.state=1) left join sts_customer e on (a.customer_id=e.id) where a.id=#{taskId}
